pillars.title: Unlimited AI Practice
pillars.summary: Train without limits, whenever you need.
pillars.body: Train your commercial force as many times as necessary, without depending on schedules, supervisors or in-person sessions. Rolplay allows practice of real conversations in an always-available, scalable environment designed to improve with every interaction.

pillars.summary: Clear, unbiased feedback in every session.
pillars.body: Each practice session generates clear, structured and bias-free feedback. The AI analyzes user performance and delivers actionable insights to improve messaging, objection handling, clarity, confidence and alignment with key messages.

pillars.title: Customized Scenarios for Every Challenge
pillars.summary: Training tailored to your real world.
pillars.body: Not all teams sell the same way or face the same challenges. Rolplay adapts training scenarios to your products, industries, client profiles, experience levels and real business situations — making training far more relevant.

pillars.body: We eliminate the awkwardness of traditional roleplay between colleagues. With Rolplay, team members can fail, repeat, correct and perfect their performance without social pressure or judgment, before facing real clients.

pillars.title: Preparation for the Moment of Truth
pillars.body: Practice only matters if it improves performance in the field. Rolplay helps each team member arrive better prepared for critical commercial conversations, with greater command of their pitch, better response capability and more confidence in front of clients.

pillars.title: Measurable and Scalable Commercial Development
pillars.body: Rolplay transforms training into an observable process. Companies can identify progress, knowledge gaps and improvement opportunities — turning commercial training into a continuous, measurable and scalable strategy.

storiesPage.heroBody: For confidentiality, our clients are identified only by their global ranking. The results, however, speak for themselves.

stories.headline: The 4th largest oil company in the world.
stories.body: We addressed the challenge of practical training for station attendants by creating a platform that allowed them to practice selling premium gasoline using differentiated messaging. As a result of this training, we effectively trained attendants, shortened the learning curve, and reduced staff turnover.

stories.headline: The 2nd largest pharmaceutical company in the world.
stories.body: We sought to standardize sales processes and the messaging created by the training department through a virtual platform that allowed representatives to practice methodology, dialogues, and selling skills. In addition, a dedicated profile was created for direct managers, enabling them to provide feedback to their medical representatives — standardizing the sales process and creating a collaborative coaching environment based on objective metrics.

stories.headline: The #1 financial and transactional solutions company in France, and the #2 largest in the world.
stories.body: A theoretical–practical training program focused on virtual sales was designed and implemented, equipping 130 sales representatives with the skills needed to sell remotely. The program strengthened the team's commercial capabilities, increasing the generation of business opportunities. Due to its success, the training was permanently integrated into the company's onboarding processes.

stories.headline: For one of the largest laboratories in Spain.
stories.body: It was necessary to transform sales training processes into something measurable, effective, and continuous. A virtual AI-powered platform was developed where medical representatives could practice their key messages. The platform automatically evaluated each exercise and delivered a clear verdict to users, while also generating reports for managers, allowing them to audit performance and training. This development standardized promotional messages, professionalized training processes, and even enabled certification of the sales force.

stories.headline: For a laboratory specialized in the treatment of overweight.
stories.body: Traditional sales training approaches generated internal friction, as salespeople often questioned the objectivity of the feedback provided by their managers. As a solution, an AI-integrated video-calling platform was developed to deliver more objective and structured coaching sessions. The platform allowed full sessions or specific segments to be recorded and compared against different evaluation criteria, standardizing feedback and significantly streamlining managers' work.

stories.headline: The 3rd largest pharmaceutical company in the world, headquartered in Switzerland.
stories.body: The goal was to standardize the sales process from medical segmentation to post-visit follow-up. A platform was created where medical representatives could practice each phase of the process. Thanks to AI-guided training, representatives were able to refine segmentation, opening, probing, objection handling, key messages, and closing techniques. The laboratory achieved full adoption of the methodology, improving the quality of visits and ensuring consistency in the commercial model across the entire sales force.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.body: Everything you need to know about Rolplay and how it works.
faqs.answerNote: We answer every question, usually the same business day.

items.a: Rolplay offers AI-powered training programs designed to improve sales team performance and maximize commercial results through innovative technology.
Rolplay is located in Mexico and Canada, serving both local and international clients.

items.q: How can artificial intelligence improve my sales team's performance?
items.a: AI provides personalized training, analysis, and strategic insights to enhance techniques, skills, and decision-making, leading to stronger sales performance and better results.

items.q: Is the training customizable for different industries?
items.a: Yes, Rolplay's AI training programs are fully customizable to match the specific needs and challenges of different industries.

items.q: How can I get started with Rolplay?
items.a: Contact us through our website or call our Mexico City office to discuss your sales team's training needs.

items.q: What kind of results can I expect from using Rolplay?
items.a: Rolplay helps sales teams improve communication clarity, increase conversion rates, reduce errors in the sales process, and build confidence when interacting with real customers. Teams typically see measurable improvements within a few weeks.

items.q: Does Rolplay require prior training to use it?
items.a: No. The platform is designed so that anyone — regardless of their technical level — can use it intuitively. It also includes guides, preconfigured scenarios, and instant AI-powered feedback to accelerate learning.

items.q: Can I integrate Rolplay with other tools in my company?
items.a: Yes. Rolplay can integrate with CRM systems, LMS platforms, and other internal tools to centralize information, automate reporting, and keep training metrics aligned with business objectives.

items.q: How does Rolplay evaluate user performance during a simulation?
items.a: Rolplay analyzes user interactions through artificial intelligence, evaluating aspects such as message clarity, objection handling, sales structure, product knowledge, and response quality. The platform provides immediate feedback and actionable metrics so each person can identify improvement areas and strengthen performance.

items.q: Is Rolplay only useful for sales teams?
items.a: No. Although Rolplay is especially useful for sales teams, it can also be applied to training, leadership, customer service, organizational culture, internal communication, knowledge certification, and preparation for critical conversations. Its flexibility makes it possible to adapt scenarios, evaluation criteria, and content to different roles within an organization.
